description: Opozorilna karta verjetnosti pojavljanja erozije 1:25.000 is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VODE. The data of the Alert Map is used for the purpose of defining the need to produce more detailed analyses to give an opinion on the erosion risk in a specific area. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VODE. The portal shows the English title as "Warning map of the probability of occurrence of erosion 1:25,000" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VODE. Its keywords include Erozija prsti, Erozija, Vodna erozija, Območja nevarnosti naravnih nesreč. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
